simple.meaning: עָנֹג (ʻânôg) is a Hebrew word meaning “luxurious.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עָנֹג (H6028) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 28:54, with occurrences in Deuteronomy, Isaiah.
